whatIsIt.eli5: Two looking windows (3 wide and 1 wide) whose results are added; after learning they become one window.
whatIsIt.simple: A 3×3 Conv+BN and a 1×1 Conv+BN run in parallel and are added, then SiLU. After training they are merged into one 3×3 Conv.
whatIsIt.engineer: act(BN(W3∗x) + BN(W1∗x) [+ BN(x)]); fused into a single 3×3 conv with bias.

whyExists.eli5: Learning is easier with two windows; using the model is faster with one.
whyExists.simple: Multi-branch training improves optimisation; single-branch inference is fast.

engineer: Optional identity-BN branch when c1 == c2 and stride 1.
